concern: (medium) Theme and branding archetype retain generic FinTech references rather than domain-specific CRIE medical normative knowledge base terminology.
jtbd: When evaluating and using the knowledge base portal, I want branding, archetype badges, and metadata to consistently reflect the CRIE medical normative knowledge base rather than placeholder FinTech references, so that medical staff and residents experience clear domain credibility and normative grounding.
